name: kawhi2x
caption:
KAWHI, TWICE 🎮🏀 We traded for him in 2018. We traded for him again in 2026.

• July 2018: we send DeMar DeRozan to San Antonio for Kawhi Leonard
• DeMar was our #1 scorer ever, 9 seasons in Toronto
• Kawhi gives us 26.6 a night, then 30.5 in the playoffs
• 2019: we win the title, Kawhi is Finals MVP
• July 2019: he signs with the Clippers
• Sept 14, 2026: we trade for him again

Can he do it twice? 👇

beats.head: THE TRADE
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: July twenty eighteen. We trade DeMar DeRozan for Kawhi Leonard.

beats.head: THE PRICE
beats.name: DEMAR
beats.vo: It hurt. DeMar was our number one scorer ever, nine seasons in Toronto.
beats.dlg: DEMAR: OUR #1 SCORER EVER.|9 SEASONS IN TORONTO.

beats.head: THE PAYOFF
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: Kawhi gives us twenty-six point six a night... then thirty point five in the playoffs.

beats.head: 2019 CHAMPS
beats.vo: Finals Game six. We win the title, and Kawhi is Finals MVP.
beats.dlg: WE WIN THE TITLE.|KAWHI: FINALS MVP!

beats.head: GONE
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: A month later, he's gone. He signs with the Clippers.

beats.head: HE'S BACK
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: Seven years later. September fourteenth, twenty twenty-six. We trade for him again.

beats.head: KAWHI, TWICE
beats.vo: Can he do it twice? Comment below.
beats.dlg: CAN HE DO IT TWICE?|COMMENT BELOW!

facts.claim: July 18, 2018: DeRozan traded to San Antonio for Kawhi Leonard; DeRozan the Raptors' #1 all-time leading scorer after 9 seasons
2019: Raptors win the title, Leonard Finals MVP; July 2019 signs with the Clippers; Sept 14, 2026 traded back to Toronto; #2 jersey
